hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds the `afterInitialize` permission but performs no action in that callback. Pool initialization and tick recording are managed externally via `initializePools()`, which delegates to an `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract. No swap or liquidity modification logic is present.
